sources.locator: PDF page 1 Specifications and Marking dimensions; page 2 Characteristics list, exact 25SVPF47M row and footnotes 1-4
sources.evidence_extract: Exact 25SVPF47M row: 25 V, 47 uF +/-20%, C6 case 6.3 mm diameter and 5.9 mm length; maximum ESR 30 milliohm at 100 to 300 kHz, 20 C; ripple 2.8 A rms at 100 kHz, 105 C; leakage 235 uA. Initial capacitance tolerance is specified at 120 Hz, 20 C. After the 5000-hour endurance test at 105 C and rated voltage, capacitance change is within +/-20% of the initial value. The polarity stripe marks the negative terminal.
